title: Water For All
summary: Restore 22 failed borewells across fourteen settlements before the next summer.
description: The Nandur cluster has been fetching water from a river nine kilometres away since its borewells failed. This campaign funds rehabilitation of all 22 sources, solar pumping where the load warrants it, and six months of monitoring once each committee takes over. Every restoration is published with its yield before and after.

title: Healthy Mothers, Healthy Villages
summary: Support 48 nutrition circles and a fortnightly mobile clinic for 3,200 mothers.
description: A single campaign backing two linked strands: the weekly nutrition circles that keep expectant and new mothers in contact with a health worker, and the mobile clinic that covers settlements with no PHC within reach. Funds are allocated against the published project budgets.

title: Back To Learning
summary: Open the last six learning centres and keep the other 24 staffed through the school year.
description: Twenty-four centres are running; this campaign closes the gap to thirty and covers facilitator payments for the full academic year so no centre closes mid-term.

title: Sixty Libraries
summary: Sixty school library corners, funded and fully delivered.
description: Completed in February 2026. The final report shows every library corner established, 180 student librarians trained and two full terms of borrowings recorded.

title: Rain-Ready Schools
summary: Recharge pits and storage tanks so no school runs dry before the monsoon returns.
description: Rooftop catchment at 40 schools, sized from measured roof area and local rainfall, with student-led level monitoring from the first fill.

title: Bring The Rain Back
summary: Treat 900 hectares of ridge land so the monsoon stops running off in a week.
description: Contour trenching on the ridge, farm ponds below it and three valley check dams, executed by the households who will use them. Vegetation cover is reported each season from satellite imagery.

title: Clean Market Yards
summary: Six public sanitation blocks, built and handed to self-help groups.
description: Closed and archived. Tariffs, cleaning rotas and usage figures for all six blocks are in the 2025 annual report.
